name: hermes-agent-camel
description: Hermes Agent fork with integrated CaMeL trust boundaries — capability-based security for agent runtime

research_provenance.note: Community implementation adapting CaMeL ideas to Hermes runtime, not Google official

key_capabilities: Trusted operator plan extraction from real user turns
Provenance-aware wrapping for untrusted tool outputs
Per-turn security envelope in system context
Capability gating for sensitive tools (terminal, file, memory, messaging, cron, skills, delegation, browser)
Memory flush and synthetic continuation turn gating
CaMeL metadata stripping before provider API calls
threat_model: Indirect prompt injection via untrusted content (web, files, MCP, session recall)
